game.title: Resident Evil 2
game.blurb: Survival horror action game, the 2019 remake of 1998's Resident Evil 2, from Capcom, released 2019-01-25. RAWG average playtime: 11 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Leon's and Claire's Stories
chapters.summary: Finishing each character's story, plus the hidden story milestones along the way. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Survival Basics
chapters.summary: Combining items, adding inventory slots, customising a weapon and boarding up windows.

chapters.title: Combat Tricks
chapters.summary: Knife kills, sub-weapon counters, grenades, lickers, zombie dogs and the Tyrant's hat.

chapters.title: Mr. Raccoons, Files, Safes and Secrets
chapters.summary: Destroying Mr. Raccoons (including in The Ghost Survivors mode), reading every file, opening safes and locks, the photo-hint items and Jill's letter.

chapters.title: Hardcore and Challenge Runs
chapters.summary: Hardcore runs for both characters, no recovery items, no item box and a low step count.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). This is the 2019 remake, with its own Steam app 883710; the Steam schema names it "RESIDENT EVIL 2 / BIOHAZARD RE:2". The Steam app list also has "Resident Evil 2 (1998)" as app 4249110, which was not used. StrategyWiki has the remake under "Resident Evil 2 (2019)" (completion stage 0); only its "Table of Contents" subpage is written. The main page links area pages (for example Police Station, Sewers, NEST and Orphanage) and Walkthrough, Items and Files pages, but none of them is written, so nothing was used. On residentevil.fandom.com, "Resident Evil 2 (2019)" redirects to "Resident Evil 2", whose categories include "Resident Evil 2 remake"; it has about 218 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 16 of 44 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the story chapter, including low-percentage ones such as "One Slick Super-spy" (6.8%), "Young Escapee" (7.2%), "Grim Reaper" (9.6%) and "Hell of a Sheriff" (6.7%), which may be harder unlocks rather than story. Leon and Claire share one story chapter because the hidden achievements cannot be split between them from the data. "Got 'Em" (The Ghost Survivors mode) is the only achievement naming that mode, so it sits with the collectibles.
